basics.name: Daniel Yamin
basics.label: Senior Algorithmic Developer & Data Scientist
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in software development, algorithms, and data science. Strong background in computational neuroscience. Career spans startups to global corporations, with expertise in building scalable systems and ML pipelines.

work.name: Franklin by QIAGEN
work.summary: Developing algorithms and data science solutions for clinical genomics interpretation platform.

work.name: Chaos Labs
work.summary: Built scalable backend systems for real-time DeFi risk platforms. Developed decentralized systems with low-latency output, enabling protocols like Aave, Uniswap, and Osmosis to incorporate dynamic risk-reducing data in smart contracts.

work.name: Sagol School of Neuroscience, Tel Aviv University
work.summary: Led research on eye movement analysis using advanced signal processing, statistics, and machine learning. Developed novel no-report paradigm for studying memory and cognition. Published research featured on Israeli national news.

work.name: Microsoft
work.summary: Azure Defender for IoT team. Built advanced security solutions for IoT & OT devices at global scale. Designed and developed Vulnerability Assessment tool matching CVEs to IoT devices using sophisticated algorithms.

work.name: Allot
work.summary: Developed DDoS Secure, a real-time network behavior anomaly detection (NBAD) and mitigation system. Strong focus on algorithmic thinking with adherence to OOP and SOLID principles.

work.name: Didact (MindCET Accelerator)
work.summary: Built innovative online marketplace for video lessons. Participated in MindCET accelerator - EdTech innovation center developing groundbreaking educational technology.

awards.title: First Prize in Allot Hackathon
awards.summary: Won first place in company-wide hackathon.

awards.title: RoboCup International Representative
awards.summary: Led team to national victory and represented Israel in international RoboCup competition in Atlanta, Georgia.

awards.title: Young Researchers Program
awards.summary: Participated in Chetz project - advanced research program during high school.

projects.name: MEGA - Memory Episode Gaze Anticipation
projects.summary: Research project introducing a novel methodology using eye-tracking technology to measure memory retrieval without verbal responses. Analyzes anticipatory gaze patterns to index episodic memory traces. Featured on Israeli national news.
